comment: Provides operations for interacting with agents using the A2A protocol.

name: SendMessage
comment: Sends a message to an agent.

name: SendStreamingMessage
comment: Sends a streaming message to an agent, allowing for real-time interaction and status updates.

name: GetTask
comment: Gets the latest state of a task.

name: ListTasks
comment: Lists tasks that match the specified filter.

name: CancelTask
comment: Cancels a task in progress.

name: SubscribeToTask
comment: Subscribes to task updates for tasks not in a terminal state.

name: CreateTaskPushNotificationConfig
comment: Creates a push notification config for a task.

name: GetTaskPushNotificationConfig
comment: Gets a push notification config for a task.

name: ListTaskPushNotificationConfigs
comment: Get a list of push notifications configured for a task.

name: GetExtendedAgentCard
comment: Gets the extended agent card for the authenticated agent.

name: DeleteTaskPushNotificationConfig
comment: Deletes a push notification config for a task.
Configuration of a send message request.

name: accepted_output_modes
comment: A list of media types the client is prepared to accept for response parts.

name: task_push_notification_config
comment: Configuration for the agent to send push notifications for task updates.

name: history_length
comment: The maximum number of most recent messages from the task's history to retrieve in the response.

name: return_immediately
comment: If `true`, the operation returns immediately after creating the task, even if processing is still in progress.
`Task` is the core unit of action for A2A.

name: id
comment: Unique identifier (e.g. UUID) for the task, generated by the server for a new task.

name: context_id
comment: Unique identifier (e.g. UUID) for the contextual collection of interactions (tasks and messages).

name: status
comment: The current status of a `Task`, including `state` and a `message`.

name: artifacts
comment: A set of output artifacts for a `Task`.

name: history
comment: The history of interactions from a `Task`.

name: metadata
comment: A key/value object to store custom metadata about a task.
Defines the possible lifecycle states of a `Task`.

name: TASK_STATE_UNSPECIFIED
comment: The task is in an unknown or indeterminate state.

name: TASK_STATE_SUBMITTED
comment: Indicates that a task has been successfully submitted and acknowledged.

name: TASK_STATE_WORKING
comment: Indicates that a task is actively being processed by the agent.

name: TASK_STATE_COMPLETED
comment: Indicates that a task has finished successfully.

name: TASK_STATE_FAILED
comment: Indicates that a task has finished with an error.

name: TASK_STATE_CANCELED
comment: Indicates that a task was canceled before completion.

name: TASK_STATE_INPUT_REQUIRED
comment: Indicates that the agent requires additional user input to proceed.

name: TASK_STATE_REJECTED
comment: Indicates that the agent has decided to not perform the task.

name: TASK_STATE_AUTH_REQUIRED
comment: Indicates that authentication is required to proceed.
A container for the status of a task

name: state
comment: The current state of this task.

name: message
comment: A message associated with the status.

name: timestamp
comment: ISO 8601 Timestamp when the status was recorded.
`Part` represents a container for a section of communication content.

name: text
comment: The string content of the `text` part.

name: raw
comment: The `raw` byte content of a file.

name: url
comment: A `url` pointing to the file's content.

name: data
comment: Arbitrary structured `data` as a JSON value (object, array, string, number, boolean, or null).

name: metadata
comment: metadata associated with this part.

name: filename
comment: An optional `filename` for the file (e.g., "document.pdf").

name: media_type
comment: The `media_type` (MIME type) of the part content (e.g., "text/plain", "application/json", "image/png").
Defines the sender of a message in A2A protocol communication.

name: ROLE_UNSPECIFIED
comment: The role is unspecified.

name: ROLE_USER
comment: The message is from the client to the server.

name: ROLE_AGENT
comment: The message is from the server to the client.
`Message` is one unit of communication between client and server.
